title: console-observability-triage-scratchpad-alex
content:
Console Observability — Daily Triage Scratchpad (personal)

Date: 2024-12-02
Owner: Alex Kim (eng-observability)
Quick context: informal notes while doing morning triage on console dashboards, customer reports, and follow-ups. Lots of unknowns still — using this to capture repro steps, ad-hoc queries, and who to ping.

Top priorities today:
- RED-1234: customer reported "missing token breakdown" on /usage -> billing dashboard (sev: high for affected customer). Customer: Acme AI.
  - First pass: dashboard still rendering, but token columns empty for dates 2024-11-20 -> 2024-11-30.
  - Hypothesis: recent pipeline change to cost-aggregation job (job-id: cost-agg-2024-11-29) dropped token-level joins for some org_ids.
  - Repro steps: impersonate Acme org -> open /console/usage -> set range 11/20-11/30 -> check token breakdown table.
  - Quick queries to run: run kusto/snowflake query to validate token counts vs raw-logs for org_id=acme_org_42 (query saved in /queries/cost-debug.sql).
  - Next actions: run query (Alex), if mismatch file bug: create PR to revert join change (Jordan), notify customer with ETA (Maya).

- Dashboard slow load: /console/model-metrics overview (noticed ~2pm PST yesterday).
  - Symptoms: API call /api/metrics/summary taking 4-6s sometimes. Traces show spikes on redis cache misses then long p99 db reads.
  - Quick checks: redis hit-rate dashboard (dash: infra/cache/redis-hitrate) — spike correlates with deploy at 11/29.
  - TODO: add temporary caching layer or increase TTL for the summary endpoint; raise RFC if needs infra change. Ping s-reliability (P1?)

- Alert flapping: alert CONSOLE_RATE_LIMIT_ERRORED firing repeatedly for a subset of routes (route: /chat/stream).
  - Look at logs: rate limiter returned 429 but request count low — suspect bug in token bucket reset logic after function-call rewrite.
  - Linked ticket: github #567 (PR touches rate limiter).
  - Quick mitigation: rollback PR on staging and monitor. If confirmed, prepare rollback on prod windows. (Jordan to coordinate).

Customer reported items to follow-up:
- Acme AI (RED-1234): ask for sample request ids and org time zone to reproduce their exact view.
- Beta customer "Novus" complaining about embedding quality shown on console metrics (might be eval/quality, not infra). Route to applied-ml for signal.

Ad-hoc investigations / scratch commands:
- SQL: SELECT org_id, date, sum(tokens) FROM token_usage WHERE org_id IN ('acme_org_42') AND date BETWEEN '2024-11-20' AND '2024-11-30' GROUP BY org_id, date;  -- compare to aggregated table tokens_by_day
- k8s: kubectl logs -n console $(kubectl get pods -n console -l app=console-api -o name) | grep "rate-limiter" --last-lines=200
- tracing: open distributed trace for /api/metrics/summary p99 > 2s, look at spans around redis and db read.

Notes from quick sync with Maya (11:15):
- Maya will draft customer-facing note for Acme, keep messaging: we have a targeted investigation, ETA 24-48h.
- Jordan will prioritize rollback PR on staging and validate redis hit patterns.

Open questions / unknowns:
- Did cost-aggregation job have a schema migration on 11/29? (check release notes / release-engineering tickets)
- Are there any recent quota changes that would surface as token counts disappearing (billing pipeline)?
- Is the rate limiter issue related to new function-calling telemetry?

Quick checklist (today):
- [ ] Run token count comparison query for Acme (Alex)
- [ ] Ping release-eng about cost-agg job (Alex)
- [ ] Coordinate rollback on staging for rate-limiter PR (Jordan)
- [ ] Draft Acme customer note (Maya)
- [ ] Monitor /console/model-metrics perf for 3h after fixes (Alex)

Follow-ups for next triage:
- Reconcile token counts and post results to RED-1234.
- Decide on permanent fix for rate limiter after root cause.
- If billing pipeline is root cause, schedule postmortem and include finance/compliance if any invoices affected.

Random TODOs / friction notes (personal):
- Clean up saved queries folder; move cost-debug.sql to queries/one-off and add README.
- Create a short runbook for common console triage steps (check redis, db, traces, recent deploys).

End of scratchpad.

(Notes to self: keep this doc informal, transfer polished notes to Confluence under confluence:console-triage when done.)
